Verdicts of the review app

Source: R/app.R
app_verdicts.Rd

Joins the verdicts written by run_app() to the clip manifest, giving the same table as classify_review() (the content of validation_by_clip.csv), so that the summaries of stage 1, the agreement between reviewers and the calibration work as with a review in the BirdNET GUI. "uncertain" verdicts are kept but, like "disagreement", left out of precision, thresholds and calibration, which use only positive and negative verdicts.

Usage

app_verdicts(manifest, verdicts_file, clips_dir = NULL, reviewer = NULL)

Arguments

manifest

Clip manifest: a data frame or the path to clip_manifest.csv (from select_clips(), cut_clips() or assign_reviewers()). With output_dir, by default <output_dir>/clip_manifest.csv when it exists.

verdicts_file

CSV written by run_app().

clips_dir

Optional folder of the clips, to fill reviewed_path (needed by build_training_set()).

reviewer

Optional reviewer: only their verdicts are used. With NULL, every reviewer's verdicts are kept, one row per clip and reviewer, ready for reviewer_agreement() and consensus_verdicts().

A clip marked more than once by the same reviewer keeps the last verdict; a message says how many clips were marked again and how many of them changed verdict.

Value

The manifest with verdict ("positive", "negative", "uncertain" or "not_reviewed"), reviewed_path and reviewer. With reviewer = NULL, a clip reviewed by two reviewers has two rows, and a clip not yet reviewed has one row with reviewer = NA.

See also

run_app(), classify_review().
